description: WHEN TO USE: To get monitoring results for a project — how LLMs responded to brand monitoring prompts. REQUIRES: project_id from lbm_list_projects. RETURNS: Compact CSV with result_id, prompt, model, brand_mentioned, status (default limit: 20). Set include_all_fields=true for full JSON. NEXT STEP: Use lbm_get_transcript with a result_id to read the full LLM response text.

include_all_fields.description: Set true for full JSON response. Default: false (compact CSV — recommended).

status.description: Optional: filter by status (success, failure, pending, queued)

tags.description: Optional: filter by comma-separated prompt tags (OR logic)

name: lbm_list_results
